title: The Steam Writing on the Cold Pane
youtube_title: The Steam Writing on the Cold Pane | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Wonder grows when you look without grabbing.
summary: At a garden path after a gentle rain, Bibi finds a steam from cocoa writing nothing and then a shape. The wish to pocket it or poke it is real, but Bibi shows Pema how to look without disturbing it. Mama looks too, and they leave it where it is.
